name: mosfet_VT0001_T6c

* VT0001 2N7002 -- switching; catalogue values from Simulation\Transistors\MY_LIB_NMOS_DS.ckt; model MY_LIB_NMOS_DS
* switching: resistive load, gate pulse 0 -> VGS, two stable states must be reached
VDD vdd 0 DC 30.0
RL vdd d 60.0
RG g gsrc 6.0
VG gsrc 0 PULSE(0 10.0 100n 1n 1n 500n 1u)
XCUT g 0 d MY_LIB_NMOS_DS PARAMS: VTO=2.069538 KP=0.62202882 THETA=1.508741 CGS=1.1e-11 CGD=2e-12 CDS=2.1e-12 ISbody=4.03031e-17 Nbody=1.0
.TRAN 20p 400n
.PLOT TRAN V(d) I(RL)
.END
